svg.title: Orlando Camacho
svg.desc: Orlando Camacho. I build autonomous robots — and the mixed-reality link that lets people step in from anywhere. Mechatronics Engineering · IBERO, Mexico City. The name is set over a real occupancy-grid map (salon_v2, 0.05 m per cell). A LiDAR sweep turns once from a point in the room and reveals the map and the name; the wall cells it returns from stay marked.
